key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.لِلْعَقْلِ: for the intellect; mental faculty and sound reason
key_terms.مَذْهَبَةٌ: a cause of diminishing or taking away

ai.seo_question: How does abandoning trade affect a person's intellect according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches that leaving trade and commercial engagement has a harmful effect on a person's intellect. The hadith highlights the value of productive economic activity and its connection to sound judgment and mental sharpness.
